name: dsh-intelligent-ui
description: Conversation-inline interactive UI for DSH: the model renders a panel (markdown, text, choices, toggles, sliders, forms with required-field checks and counters, tables, multi-step wizards, inline SVG charts, line diffs, timelines, checkbox trees, progress bars, tabs, native path picker, file upload) and blocks until the user answers; every answer-collecting panel also carries a forced note box (values.user_note) so the user can always say what they actually want instead of picking the least bad option; answers are logged and can be replayed later, ready-made approval/picker/plan/survey/form panels come as templates, and the plugin registers a runtime skill plus a system-prompt capability note so the model actually reaches for a panel.
author: lyjyy
